newsitem.title: USA: Insituform East sees Q1 off, later better.
newsitem.headline: Insituform East sees Q1 off, later better.

text.p: Insituform East Inc said on Tuesday, after the market closed, that it expects the less favorable results of its last two quarters of fiscal 1996 to extend or expand through the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
The company said it sees favorable results over the remainder of the year, based on anticipated increases in immediately workable backlog.
Insituform East reported earnings for the fourth quarter ended June 30 of $0.05 a share, compared with $0.15 a share the previous fourth quarter.
The company said it believes the trenchless pipeline reconstruction market is continuing to expand.
However, it said that more "imitation and subsititute products" have entered the market with cheap prices.
